records.text: Brigitte Macron's family had worked for Israel for a long time because they owed Israel a favor connected to the family's alleged German and Nazi background.

appearances.snippet: Beware the wives of. Beware the wives of. Again, it was a tip that we had received, so I can't say it's definitively, but the story that was shared with me about Brigitte's background was very on par with my research into his mysterious family origin, why he's wearing this wig. And in short, they had alleged that Brigitte's family was working on behalf of Israel for a very long time because they owed Israel a very big favor because allegedly her family is really from Germany, which is what I was discovering.

verification.notes: The transcript itself qualifies this as a tip and allegation. Live searches found no reliable records supporting a German/Nazi family background, an Israeli debt, or long-term work for Israel by Brigitte Macron's family.

records.text: The Israeli government covered up a 1950s story about Brigitte Macron's family working for the Nazis, after which her family worked for Israel.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 7ERqbYElOfs)

appearances.snippet: And they had been working on behalf of the Nazis and it became a rather big story in the 50s and the Israeli government cleaned it up for them. That's the short and the thick of it, that Brigitte's family has worked for Israel since and now, yeah, she works for the president and there are some stories about how she has allegedly betrayed France and Paris working on behalf of Israel.

verification.notes: Live searches found no reliable source for a 1950s Israeli government cover-up involving Brigitte Macron's family or subsequent work by the family for Israel. Absence of corroboration is recorded as unverifiable, not false.
